rule: A gate passes only when every task of its entry plan tasks is done, its exit criteria hold and its evidence is recorded. Set status to passed and record merge_sha (the commit that holds the passing state) and evidence. Never mark a gate passed with a mock where the exit criteria name a real component.

gates.title: Seam frozen
gates.exit_criteria: Seam request acknowledged by both Risk developers; Appendix C types and interfaces compiled in oracle/src unchanged; interface hash recorded here.
gates.interface_hash_command: cd oracle && cat $(ls src/types/*.sol src/interfaces/*.sol | LC_ALL=C sort) | sha256sum

gates.title: Contracts complete
gates.exit_criteria: Oracle CI green (FOUNDRY_PROFILE=ci: fmt, build with sizes, unit, fuzz, invariant ORC-1..15, real UMA, seam, vectors); internal review of the contracts diff by OB recorded.

gates.title: Layer 1 simulated on testnet
gates.exit_criteria: E1 passes in sim mode on Monad testnet; the 429 and NOT_READY cases are logged with no report written.

gates.title: Testnet E2E (stub engine)
gates.exit_criteria: E1-E11 all pass on Monad testnet with the stub engine; evidence logged.

gates.title: Testnet E2E (real engine and factory)
gates.exit_criteria: E1-E11 all pass against the real engine and MarketFactory after Risk G6/G7 (DEP-1/2); differences from the stub run explained.

gates.title: Mainnet launch
gates.exit_criteria: Every item of the plan section 12.10 mainnet launch checklist is ticked with evidence.
